mapper.select: SELECT id, card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card
AND (card_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR realname_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND card_type = #{cardType}
AND card_status = #{cardStatus}
ORDER BY card_type IS NULL, card_type ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY agent_name IS NULL, agent_name ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY department IS NULL, department ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY realname_name IS NULL, realname_name ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY card_status IS NULL, card_status ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phone_card (card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{cardNumber}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{realnameId}, #{realnameName}, #{department}, #{cardStatus}, #{cardType}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_card
AND card_type = #{cardType}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_card
AND card_status = #{cardStatus}
SELECT agent_name AS agentName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card WHERE agent_name IS NOT NULL AND agent_name != '' GROUP BY agent_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT card_status AS cardStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card GROUP BY card_status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m') AS monthLabel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card WHERE update_time IS NOT NULL AND card_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY monthLabel ASC LIMIT 12
